helpPage.helpPage:title: Help Support
helpPage.helpPage:centerDesc: Use this support center to jump to the right MediConeckt feature, troubleshoot common issues, and understand when to contact urgent help outside the app.
helpPage.helpPage:aiWellnessDesc: Ask mental-wellness questions, use voice input, get quick replies, and continue your recent AI chat from the dashboard.
helpPage.helpPage:counselorDesc: Browse counselors by name, specialization, language, location, rating, and online status before starting care.
helpPage.helpPage:appointmentsDesc: Review upcoming and past appointments, check request status, and book sessions with available counselors.
helpPage.helpPage:walletDesc: Add money, review transactions, download wallet reports, and contact support for payment questions.
helpPage.helpPage:checklist1: Confirm your internet connection and refresh the app before reporting a loading issue.
helpPage.helpPage:checklist2: Keep the latest screenshot, exact time, and the screen name ready when contacting support.
helpPage.helpPage:checklist3: For camera, microphone, notification, and location issues, check device app permissions first.
helpPage.helpPage:checklist4: For payment issues, include date, amount, transaction status, and wallet balance shown in the app.
helpPage.helpPage:aiChatNotReplyDesc: Check your internet connection, try sending a short message, and reopen the AI chat from the dashboard. If it still fails, share the exact error screenshot with support.
helpPage.helpPage:counselorChatNotOpenDesc: Open Counselor Support, choose an available counselor, and wait for the request to be accepted. Existing chats appear in the counselor chat screen.
helpPage.helpPage:callNotConnectingDesc: Make sure the counselor has accepted your chat/session, both users are online, and microphone/camera permissions are allowed.
helpPage.helpPage:walletPaymentIssueDesc: Open Wallet to review the latest transaction and download a report. Share the date, amount, and transaction status when contacting support.
helpPage.helpPage:languageWrongDesc: Use the language selector from the dashboard/settings. Some counselor or medical details may remain in the language entered by the provider.
helpPage.helpPage:needMoreHelpDesc: Update account details from Profile/Settings, or email support with screenshots, app version, user email/phone, and the exact time the issue happened. For crisis support in India, call 9152987821 or local emergency services.

privacyPage.privacyPage:title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.privacyPage:centerDesc: This privacy center explains how MediConeckt uses your profile, chat, appointment, wallet, call, location, and security data inside this mobile app.
privacyPage.privacyPage:profileHealthDesc: Your name, anonymous display name, age, gender, contact details, photo/avatar, address, emergency contact, basic medical details, and insurance fields are used to maintain your patient profile.
privacyPage.privacyPage:aiConversationsDesc: Messages, quick replies, chat status, attachments, accepted chat sessions, and counselor details are used to provide conversations, continue history, and support rating prompts.
privacyPage.privacyPage:appointmentsDesc: Appointment date, time, reason/notes, status, assigned counselor, call metadata, and session history help users and counselors manage care.
privacyPage.privacyPage:walletDesc: Wallet balance, top-ups, transaction records, generated reports, and related support context are used for payment tracking.
privacyPage.privacyPage:locationDesc: Location can be captured at signup, login, or manual refresh to verify sessions, support account safety, and improve location-aware care features.
privacyPage.privacyPage:securityDesc: Login tokens, auth provider, password status, OTP verification, role, and account status are used to keep user and counselor areas separated and protected.
privacyPage.privacyPage:visibleDesc: Your dashboard shows your profile, AI chats, counselor interactions, appointments, wallet, call history, ratings prompts, and location/update controls.
privacyPage.privacyPage:sharedDesc: Counselors may see the information needed to manage accepted sessions, appointments, and support conversations. Anonymous identity is used where supported.
privacyPage.privacyPage:protectedDesc: User and counselor areas are separated by role, active sessions, OTP verification, and authenticated API requests.
privacyPage.privacyPage:checklistItem1: Use your anonymous name for counselor interactions when you do not want your real name displayed.
privacyPage.privacyPage:checklistItem2: Keep emergency contact and medical profile details accurate if you choose to fill them in.
privacyPage.privacyPage:checklistItem3: Review device permissions for location, camera, and microphone before calls.
privacyPage.privacyPage:checklistItem4: Update location manually from Settings/Profile if the login prompt was skipped.
privacyPage.privacyPage:checklistItem5: Do not share OTPs, passwords, or sensitive account details inside chat messages.
privacyPage.privacyPage:checklistItem6: Use My Profile and Settings to update or review the data stored in your account.
